messages:
Maria (CS): Quick triage — ChaufferCorp usage has dropped ~60% over the last 14d. Seat activity and API calls both down. Procurement lead changed this week (Raj Patel) and CTO mentioned they're running a perf pilot with VectorLabs. Need a renewal-risk playbook and quick remediation. Anyone available?

AJ (Solutions): digging into logs now. Any signal on webhook failures or auth? pinging @Oliver for infra perf notes.

Oliver (Eng): I saw a spike in 4xx/429 from their org_id 98765 on 2025-03-20 — looks like integration/credentials mismatch. Quick snippets from the proxy logs: 
```
{"org_id":"98765","status":"400","path":"/v1/generate","error":"invalid-api-key"}
{"org_id":"98765","status":"429","path":"/v1/embeddings","error":"rate_limit"}
```

Oliver (Eng): That invalid-api-key would explain the sudden drop — their deploy likely didn't rotate keys after their infra change.

Devon (Sales): they're mid-contract (annual, renewal in ~45 days). If CTO is evaluating a competitor we should (1) get them back up ASAP and (2) offer a short performance proof to prevent momentum loss. I can prep a commercial play.

Maria (CS): Proposed immediate actions:
- (1) Outreach: quick async note to Raj offering a 30-min troubleshooting call (AJ + Oliver) — today.
- (2) Tech: confirm credentials & SDK version; Oliver to provide repro steps / ETA.
- (3) Commercial: offer a 2-week dedicated throughput burst (no charge) to prove perf — Devon to draft offer.
- (4) Exec: schedule a short QBR + demo for CTO showing smart routing / fallbacks. I'll own scheduling.

AJ (Solutions): Drafting outreach now. Short checklist to send: 
"Hi Raj — noticed a drop in API traffic. Quick checklist: (a) confirm API key in env matches the key in the dashboard, (b) ensure SDK v>=1.4.2, (c) run one sample request below and paste the response."

Integrations Bot: New support ticket created: CH-1129 — "ChaufferCorp integration failure: invalid-api-key". Link: https://support.redwood/ch/1129

Maria (CS): I'll tag reason codes in CRM: ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_evaluation"]. Marking renewal flag: at-risk until QBR.

Devon (Sales): Can someone share last 6 months usage snapshot (tokens & seat activity)? I'll draft the mitigation email + the dedicated-trial PO.

Maria (CS): Quick snapshot link: https://redwood.screenshots/cc_usage_6m.png

Oliver (Eng): I can rotate their API key and send step-by-step instructions to Raj. ETA ~30m.

AJ (Solutions): Scheduled a 45m troubleshooting call with Raj + their engineering manager. I'll attach the runbook and test script (post-call).

Devon (Sales): I'll prepare the trial terms: "2-week dedicated burst, SLA 99.9%, complimentary" and route to Legal for rapid sign-off.

Maria (CS): Thanks all — please update this thread when CH-1129 is resolved and when the QBR is booked. I'll follow up with an exec-level summary for the customer success leadership. :white_check_mark:
